rules.title: EKS Clusters should have the public access disabled
rules.resolution: Don't enable public access to EKS Clusters

rules.title: EKS cluster should not have open CIDR range for public access
rules.resolution: Don't enable public access to EKS Clusters

rules.title: A security group rule should not allow unrestricted egress to any IP address.
rules.resolution: Set a more restrictive cidr range

rules.title: Ensure AKS has an API Server Authorized IP Ranges enabled
rules.resolution: Limit the access to the API server to a limited IP range

rules.title: The default action on Storage account network rules should be set to deny
rules.resolution: Set network rules to deny

rules.title: S3 Access block should block public ACL
rules.resolution: Enable blocking any PUT calls with a public ACL specified

rules.title: S3 Access block should block public policy
rules.resolution: Prevent policies that allow public access being PUT

rules.title: S3 Access Block should Ignore Public ACL
rules.resolution: Enable ignoring the application of public ACLs in PUT calls

rules.title: S3 Access block should restrict public bucket to limit access
rules.resolution: Limit the access to public buckets to only the owner or AWS Services (eg; CloudFront)

rules.title: S3 encryption should use Customer Managed Keys
rules.resolution: Use SSE-KMS with a customer managed key (CMK)

rules.title: Disallow unrestricted S3 IAM Policies
rules.resolution: Create more restrictive S3 policies

rules.title: Ensure RBAC is enabled on AKS clusters
rules.resolution: Enable RBAC

rules.title: Ensure AKS cluster has Network Policy configured
rules.resolution: Configure a network policy

rules.title: SSL connections to a SQL database instance should be enforced.
rules.resolution: Enforce SSL for all connections

rules.title: Master authorized networks should be configured on GKE clusters
rules.resolution: Enable master authorized networks

rules.title: RDS IAM Database Authentication Disabled
rules.resolution: Modify the PostgreSQL and MySQL type RDS instances to enable IAM database authentication.

rules.title: RDS Deletion Protection Disabled
rules.resolution: Modify the RDS instances to enable deletion protection.

rules.title: VPC Flow Logs is a feature that enables you to capture information about the IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in your VPC. After you've created a flow log, you can view and retrieve its data in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. It is recommended that VPC Flow Logs be enabled for packet "Rejects" for VPCs.
rules.resolution: Enable flow logs for VPC

rules.title: S3 Data should be versioned
rules.resolution: Enable versioning to protect against accidental/malicious removal or modification

rules.title: Point in time recovery should be enabled to protect DynamoDB table
rules.resolution: Enable point in time recovery

rules.title: EKS Clusters should have cluster control plane logging turned on
rules.resolution: Enable logging for the EKS control plane

rules.title: Ensure server parameter 'log_connections' is set to 'ON' for PostgreSQL Database Server
rules.resolution: Enable connection logging

rules.title: Ensure server parameter 'connection_throttling' is set to 'ON' for PostgreSQL Database Server
rules.resolution: Enable connection throttling logging

rules.title: Ensure server parameter 'log_checkpoints' is set to 'ON' for PostgreSQL Database Server
rules.resolution: Enable checkpoint logging

rules.title: Databases should have the minimum TLS set for connections
rules.resolution: Use the most modern TLS policies available

rules.title: Ensure AKS logging to Azure Monitoring is Configured
rules.resolution: Enable logging for AKS

rules.title: Ensure AKS cluster has private cluster enabled
rules.resolution: Provision the AKS cluster with `private_cluster_enabled = true` and use private endpoints.

rules.title: Storage account should have logging enabled
rules.resolution: Enable logging for at least one storage service (Queue, Table, or Blob)

rules.title: Storage account should use customer-managed keys for encryption
rules.resolution: Configure customer-managed keys for storage account encryption

rules.title: Storage account should have infrastructure encryption enabled
rules.resolution: Enable infrastructure encryption for storage account

rules.title: Cloud Storage Bucket Versioning Disabled
rules.resolution: Enable object versioning on Cloud Storage buckets to preserve older versions of objects. In Terraform, set `versioning { enabled = true }` for the bucket resource.

rules.title: Temporary file logging should be enabled for all temporary files.
rules.resolution: Enable temporary file logging for all files

rules.title: Ensure that logging of connections is enabled.
rules.resolution: Enable connection logging.

rules.title: Ensure that logging of lock waits is enabled.
rules.resolution: Enable lock wait logging.

rules.title: Ensure that logging of disconnections is enabled.
rules.resolution: Enable disconnection logging.

rules.title: Enable automated backups to recover from data-loss
rules.resolution: Enable automated backups

rules.title: Ensure that logging of checkpoints is enabled.
rules.resolution: Enable checkpoints logging.

rules.title: Checks for service account defined for GKE nodes
rules.resolution: Use limited permissions for service accounts to be effective

rules.title: Network Policy should be enabled on GKE clusters
rules.resolution: Enable network policy

rules.title: Clusters should be set to private
rules.resolution: Enable private cluster

rules.title: Disable Default Firewall Rules
rules.resolution: Replace default firewall rules with custom, more restrictive rules appropriate for your security requirements

rules.title: Google Compute Subnetwork Logging Disabled
rules.resolution: Enable VPC Flow Logs for subnets. In Terraform, set `enable_flow_logs = true` in the `google_compute_subnetwork` resource.

rules.title: Cloud Storage Bucket Logging Not Enabled
rules.resolution: Enable Access and Storage logs for Cloud Storage buckets by configuring a log sink or specifying a `log_bucket` in Terraform.
